'''Metalwork droids''' were used<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> around [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> to help repair structural damage sustained by [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in deep space. About half a dozen of these small [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were used aboard the doomed vessel ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' in an attempt to repair the damage caused by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] and the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
